title: React-Form-Toaster
description: Pass one JSON-like schema for fields, buttons, validation, and styling — the library handles layout, state, errors, password toggles, file uploads, and toasts automatically.

blocks.title: Why it exists
blocks.text: Forms repeat the same boilerplate — useState per field, error text, loading buttons. React-Form-Toaster centralizes that in a declarative schema with Zod validation and optional built-in toasts.

blocks.code:
npm install react-form-toaster
# or
yarn add react-form-toaster

items: 100% schema & JSON driven — fields, buttons, validation, styling
Zero boilerplate — no repetitive hooks per input
Granular styling via className (Tailwind) and inline style
Flexible toasts — built-in or toast={false} for your library

columns.title: mode="inline"
columns.body: Embed as a card in your page — great for account settings, onboarding, and dashboards.

columns.title: mode="modal"
columns.body: Popup flows — delete confirmations, quick edits, and destructive actions.

blocks.text: Shipped Tailwind utilities work in className on fields, buttons, titles, and containers. Use style for arbitrary values (custom hex). When both set the same property, inline style wins.

blocks.code:
className="bg-pink-600 text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-3"
style={{ backgroundColor: "#6366f1", color: "#ffffff" }}

blocks.caption: Validation, select, showWhen, password toggle, async submit, toasts.

blocks.text: Same schema approach for delete-account, remove resource, reset data — type DELETE to confirm, modal mode, red submit button.
